No allergen statement anywhere, so every note below is inference from the dish. ⚠ READ THIS FIRST, BECAUSE IT DECIDES ALMOST EVERYTHING HERE: at an Indian restaurant the curry is usually the safe half and THE BREAD IS THE PROBLEM.
